Sandbox_EnableEntryActions_tooltip: Master toggle for all forced-entry features: crowbar prying, screwdriver lockpicking, and bolt cutters. Turn this off to fully disable entry mechanics for the whole server.
Sandbox_EnablePrySystem_tooltip: Allow crowbar prying of locked doors, windows, and garage doors. Strength-based success with noise generation.
Sandbox_EnableScrewdriverLockpick_toolti: Allow using a screwdriver to quietly pick building door locks.
Sandbox_PrySuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales pry success chance. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double chance, 0.5 = half chance.
Sandbox_PryNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales noise generated by prying. Higher values attract more zombies.
Sandbox_LockpickSuccessMultiplier_toolti: Scales lockpick success chance. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double chance.
Sandbox_LockpickNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales noise from lockpicking. Default 0.4 = very quiet.
Sandbox_InjuryChance_tooltip: Chance of minor hand injury when prying or lockpicking. 0.0 = disabled, 1.0 = guaranteed.
Sandbox_ToolWearMultiplier_tooltip: Scales condition loss on crowbars, screwdrivers, and bolt cutters during entry actions.
Sandbox_EnableAlternateCanOpening_toolti: Allow opening cans and jars with knives and screwdrivers instead of a can opener.
Sandbox_CanInjuryChance_tooltip: Chance of a cut when opening cans with a knife. 0.0 = disabled.
Sandbox_EnableRepairExtensions_tooltip: Right-click damaged items to repair them. Also enables alternative repair materials like duct tape and glue.
Sandbox_EnableRepairAllClothing_tooltip: Adds a 'Repair All Clothing' right-click option that restores every worn garment to full condition and removes all sewn-on patches in one action. Costs 1 thread use, 1 needle wear, and 1 fabric strip per damaged garment. Requires Enable repair extensions.
Sandbox_EnableTearAllNearbyClothing_tool: Adds the Tear All Nearby Clothing right-click option that pulls tearable clothes from nearby loot containers before tearing them. Turn this off to keep only selected/inventory Tear All actions.
Sandbox_EnableEquipmentQoL_tooltip: Battery swap, lighter refill, cloth tearing, bandage crafting, and other equipment shortcuts.
Sandbox_EnableCorpseIgnite_tooltip: Right-click corpses to ignite them with a lighter or matches.
Sandbox_EnablePlayerMapTracking_tooltip: Show other players on the world map and minimap in multiplayer.
Sandbox_PlayerMapVisibilityMode_tooltip: 1 = everyone sees all players, 2 = admins only, 3 = disabled.
Sandbox_EnableSeatbeltProtection_tooltip: Toggle seatbelt with Numpad + for crash damage reduction while driving.
Sandbox_EnableWalkingItemActions_tooltip: Continue actions while walking instead of stopping: reading books / magazines / newspapers / comics / maps, wearing and unwearing clothing, crafting, and handcrafting. Sprinting still cancels. Per-player override available in the in-game CSR Settings panel.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleMechanicsQoL_toolti: Batch uninstall vehicle parts (all tires, lights, windows, doors).
Sandbox_EnableImprovisedHotwire_tooltip: Hotwire vehicles with a screwdriver when lacking Electrical/Mechanics skills or the Burglar trait.
Sandbox_EnableUnHotwire_tooltip: Add a 'Remove Hotwire' option to the vehicle radial menu when seated as driver with the engine off and a screwdriver in inventory.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleDoorPry_tooltip: Pry locked vehicle doors and hatches with a crowbar via the radial menu (V key).
Sandbox_EnableGarageDoorPry_tooltip: Allow crowbar prying on garage doors and roll-up doors.
Sandbox_EnableSafeDoorPry_tooltip: Allow prying reinforced and safe doors. Requires high Strength. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_ReinforcedDoorLevel_tooltip: Minimum Strength level required to attempt prying reinforced doors.
Sandbox_VehicleWindowShatterChance_toolt: Percent chance that a vehicle window shatters when prying a locked door.
Sandbox_EnableWashMenuSplits_tooltip: Sort the wash context menu by water requirement for easier item selection.
Sandbox_EnableDashboardHighlights_toolti: Color-tint vehicle dashboard gauges (battery, engine temp, heater) for at-a-glance status.
Sandbox_EnablePourCanContents_tooltip: Right-click open containers to pour contents on the ground.
Sandbox_EnableProximityLootHelper_toolti: Tab key opens a searchable panel showing nearby ground items with Grab All support.
Sandbox_EnableGroundCleanup_tooltip: Periodic server-side removal of ground items near players. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_GroundCleanupMinutes_tooltip: How often ground cleanup runs. Default 1440 = once per in-game day.
Sandbox_GroundCleanupScanRadius_tooltip: Tile radius around players to scan for ground items during cleanup.
Sandbox_GroundCleanupMaxZ_tooltip: Highest floor level (Z) to include in ground cleanup scans.
Sandbox_GroundCleanupMaxPerScan: Ground cleanup max items per scan
Sandbox_GroundCleanupMaxPerScan_tooltip: Maximum number of items removed per cleanup cycle to limit server load.
Sandbox_LogGroundCleanup_tooltip: Print ground cleanup activity to the server log for monitoring.
Sandbox_EnableItemWipeScheduler_tooltip: Periodically force-removes all dropped ground items near players. Countdown shown on the CSR Utility HUD. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_ItemWipeIntervalMinutes_tooltip: How often the forced item wipe runs, in real-world minutes (independent of in-game time speed). Default 360 = every 6 real hours. Min 15 (15 min), max 10080 (1 week).
Sandbox_ItemWipeWarnMinutes: Item wipe warning lead time (real-world minutes)
Sandbox_ItemWipeWarnMinutes_tooltip: Sends a one-time chat warning to all players when the upcoming wipe is this many real-world minutes away. Default 60 = warn 1 hour before. Set 0 to disable the warning.
Sandbox_EnableZombieDensityOverlay_toolt: Shows a colored grid of zombie density on the world map and a small movable 'Nearby Density' HUD on screen.
Sandbox_ZombieDensityCellRadius_tooltip: How many cells around the player to scan and draw on the world map. 1 = 3x3 grid (cheap), 2 = 5x5 (default), 3 = 7x7 (most coverage, highest cost).
Sandbox_EnableZombieDensityMinimap_toolt: This option no longer does anything. The minimap heat map was removed in v1.6.7 and replaced by the on-screen Nearby Density HUD widget for performance reasons.
Sandbox_EnableCityStandpipes_tooltip: Use fire hydrants as water sources with a pipe wrench. Requires minimum Strength.
Sandbox_EnableUtilityHud_tooltip: Draggable HUD panel with quick toggles and status info. Toggle with Numpad /.
Sandbox_EnableCSRRadialMenu_tooltip: Adds a V-key CSR radial for core panels and quick actions when not interacting with vehicles. Vehicle-specific CSR actions move to the vehicle radial while enabled.
Sandbox_EnablePlayerTrading_tooltip: Enables the CSR gold-themed multiplayer player trading UI. Uses Project Zomboid's built-in secure trade transfer flow.
Sandbox_EnableLootFilter_tooltip: Hide unwanted items across 15 categories. Toggle panel with Backslash key.
Sandbox_EnableVisualSoundCues_tooltip: Directional ring overlay showing nearby sounds categorized by source (zombie/vehicle/player).
Sandbox_EnableClipboardQoL_tooltip: Write and read checklists on clipboard items.
Sandbox_EnableItemInsightTooltips_toolti: Show extra info on item tooltips: freshness timers, condition, nutrition, drainable %, and duplicate warnings.
Sandbox_EnableSmartVehicleKeyLabels_tool: Auto-name vehicle keys based on the vehicle and allow renaming them.
Sandbox_EnableEatAllStack_tooltip: Right-click a food stack to eat the entire stack in one action.
Sandbox_EnableMagazineBatchActions_toolt: Load or unload all matching magazines at once.
Sandbox_EnableQuickDeviceToggle_tooltip: Turn radios and TVs on or off directly from the right-click context menu.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeMinimumStrength_too: Minimum Strength level required to operate a fire hydrant standpipe.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseDuration_toolti: Base timed action duration in ticks for operating a standpipe.
Sandbox_EnableKnowledgeSharing_tooltip: Teach recipes and give skill XP lectures to nearby players in multiplayer.
Sandbox_EnableQuickSit_tooltip: Sit on furniture or the ground with Numpad - key.
Sandbox_KnowledgeMinTeacherLevel_tooltip: Minimum skill level required to teach a recipe or give a lecture.
Sandbox_KnowledgeRecipeLessonTime_toolti: Timed action duration for teaching a recipe (in ticks).
Sandbox_KnowledgeLectureTime_tooltip: Timed action duration for giving a skill XP lecture (in ticks).
Sandbox_KnowledgeLectureXpMultiplier_too: Multiplier for XP awarded to students during a lecture.
Sandbox_KnowledgeLectureMaxStudentLevel_: Maximum skill level a student can reach through lectures. Students at or above this level receive no XP. Uses this instead of the vanilla media cutoff.
Sandbox_CityStandpipeBaseMuscleStrain_to: Base muscle strain applied when operating a standpipe. Higher values increase fatigue.
Sandbox_EnableWeaponHudOverlay_tooltip: Show ammo count pills on the hotbar, equipped panel, and aiming crosshair.
Sandbox_EnableMaskHud_tooltip: Show a small slot next to the hotbar with the equipped (or carried) gas mask. Click to toggle wear, right-click to replace filter. Hidden when no mask is in inventory.
Sandbox_EnableStatusBar_tooltip: Show a horizontal status bar above the hotbar with health, hunger, thirst, fatigue, endurance, stress and other survival stats. Right-click any cell to customize. Affected stats glow with their warning color.
Sandbox_EnableEquipmentPanel_tooltip: Show a side panel attached to the inventory window with all worn items rendered over a live 3D model of your character. Drag items into slots to wear, right-click slots for context options.
Sandbox_EquipmentPanelDockMode_tooltip: Docked: panel sticks to the inventory window and opens with it. Floating: panel is free-floating and toggles with the Equipment Panel hotkey (default Numpad 1). Disabled: turn the panel off entirely (alias of Enable equipment panel = false).
Sandbox_EnableBarrelCapFix: Fix barrel cap loss after move
Sandbox_EnableBarrelCapFix_tooltip: When a fluid barrel is picked up and replaced via Move Furniture, restore the Cap / Uncap context menu and preserve the previous capped state. Compatible with most third-party barrel mods.
Sandbox_EnablePerfumeAsDisinfectant_tool: Allow small high-alcohol bottles such as cologne and perfume to be used as wound disinfectant. Vodka and rubbing alcohol still take priority when available.
Sandbox_EnableLighterUses_tooltip: Override the maximum number of uses for vanilla lighters and matches with the values set below.
Sandbox_LighterMaxUses_tooltip: Maximum uses for the refillable Zippo-style lighter. Vanilla default: 100.
Sandbox_EnableHydrationSense_tooltip: Automatically handles drinking from carried fluids when thirsty, or reminds players in manual mode.
Sandbox_HydrationSenseMode_tooltip: Auto drinks safe water and beverages when thirsty. Manual only shows a thirst reminder halo.
Sandbox_DangerousThirst_tooltip: When ON, Hydration Sense may use hazardous fluids as a severe-thirst last resort after all safe drinks are gone. Default OFF.
Sandbox_DisposableLighterMaxUses_tooltip: Maximum uses for the disposable plastic lighter. Vanilla default: 100.
Sandbox_MatchesMaxUses_tooltip: Maximum uses per matchbook before it runs out. Vanilla default: 5.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClaim_tooltip: Claim and lock vehicles to specific players. Manage allowed player access.
Sandbox_MaxVehicleClaims_tooltip: Maximum number of vehicles a player can claim at once.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClock_tooltip: Display a 12-hour clock on the vehicle dashboard.
Sandbox_EnableSweepTrash_tooltip: Use a broom and garbage bag to clean floor trash and debris tiles.
Sandbox_EnableSweepAshes_tooltip: Right-click a burnt-floor / ash pile while holding a broom to sweep it away. Has a chance to drop charcoal.
Sandbox_SweepAshesCharcoalChance_tooltip: Percent chance per swept ash pile to receive one charcoal. Default 33.
Sandbox_EnableMultipleSafehouse_tooltip: Allow players to claim more than one safehouse.
Sandbox_EnableCSRClaimsOverride_tooltip: Replace the vanilla safehouse claim flow with the CSR-owned claims registry. Required for faction and vehicle claims to share a single authoritative server-side store. Disabling this falls back to the legacy vanilla flow.
Sandbox_EnableClaimInvites_tooltip: Officers and above may send invitations to add players to a claim. Targets receive an Accept / Decline pop-up.
Sandbox_ClaimAuditLog_tooltip: Writes claim/release/transfer/invite/kick events to csr_claims_audit.txt and exposes the last 200 to the in-game audit viewer.
Sandbox_ClaimInviteCooldownMin_tooltip: Minimum minutes between two invites sent to the same target by the same inviter for the same claim.
Sandbox_ClaimDissolveAction_tooltip: What to do with claims belonging to a faction that no longer exists. Transfer = promote highest-rank member to personal owner. Release = release the claim outright.
Sandbox_ClaimAdminsInvisible: Admins do not appear on members list
Sandbox_ClaimAdminsInvisible_tooltip: Admins still have full management rights, but their stealth/spectator activity is not echoed into row.membersCSV / audit log lines.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidEnabled_tooltip: When active, outsiders may build/dismantle and/or loot inside claims during the configured hour window. Sleep prevention still applies outside the window.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidStart_tooltip: Hour of day (0..23) when the raid window opens.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidEnd_tooltip: Hour of day (0..23) when the raid window closes. If end is less than start the window wraps midnight.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidAllowBuild_tooltip: Outsiders can build and dismantle structures inside the claim during the window.
Sandbox_ClaimRaidAllowLoot_tooltip: Outsiders can take items and drive claimed vehicles during the window.
Sandbox_ClaimContainerProtect_tooltip: Block non-members from taking items out of containers and from picking up furniture inside a claim.
Sandbox_ClaimPadlockEnabled_tooltip: Co-owners may install Padlock items on claimed containers and vehicles. Issues a matching key. Bolt cutters can break locks.
Sandbox_ClaimPadlockBreakSeconds_tooltip: How long bolt cutters take to cut a CSR padlock.
Sandbox_MaxSafehouseClaims_tooltip: Maximum number of safehouses a player can claim at once.
Sandbox_EnableClaimExpansion_tooltip: Allow owners and co-owners to expand personal and faction safehouse claims through the CSR Claims Manager.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxWidth_tooltip: Maximum final width, in tiles, for a player-expanded safehouse claim.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxHeight_tooltip: Maximum final height, in tiles, for a player-expanded safehouse claim.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaxAddedTiles_tool: Maximum number of new tiles one expansion can add. Set 0 for no per-expansion added-tile cap.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionCooldownMinutes_to: Minimum real-time minutes between successful expansions of the same claim by the same player. Set 0 to disable.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMoneyPer10Tiles_to: Number of Base.Money items consumed for every 10 newly added tiles. Set 0 to disable the money cost.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionMaterialsPer10Tile: Construction material points consumed for every 10 newly added tiles. Raw planks, metal materials, pipes, bars, branches, rods, and CSR material bundles count.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionRequireArchitect_t: When enabled, the expanding player must be an Architect-style profession, Carpenter, Construction Worker, Engineer, admin, or meet the configured Carpentry level.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionArchitectCarpentry: Minimum Carpentry level that satisfies the architect requirement when the player does not have a matching profession.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionRequirePlayerInsid: When enabled, the player must stand inside the current safehouse claim to expand it.
Sandbox_ClaimExpansionBlockNonMembersIns: When enabled, expansion fails if a non-member player is standing inside the newly added area.
Sandbox_EnableFirework_tooltip: Craft and throw fireworks to create a 30-second zombie confusion zone with visual effects.
Sandbox_EnableBoltCutter_tooltip: Cut through metal gates, security doors, and garage doors with bolt cutters.
Sandbox_BoltCutSuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales bolt cutter success chance. 1.0 = normal.
Sandbox_EnableFenceCutting_tooltip: Lets bolt cutters cut through wire-mesh and barbed-wire fence panels. Successful cuts drop wire (and barbed wire if present) at your feet. Requires Enable bolt cutter entry.
Sandbox_FenceCutTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how long it takes to cut a wire fence panel. 1.0 = normal, higher = slower.
Sandbox_EnableDualWield_tooltip: Left-hand unarmed punch follow-up attack. Experimental feature.
Sandbox_EnableOffhandHudOverlay_tooltip: Keeps the off-hand weapon icon visible during brief engine slot clears (primary equip, ranged swings). Requires dual wielding to be enabled.
Sandbox_EnableOffhandPersist_tooltip: Re-equips the off-hand weapon after vanilla clears the secondary hand slot during primary equip or attack actions. Requires dual wielding to be enabled.
Sandbox_EnableAdvancedSoundOptions_toolt: Unlock PZ's hidden per-sound volume controls in the options menu.
Sandbox_EnableSawAllDropToGround: Saw All drops planks on ground
Sandbox_EnableSawAllDropToGround_tooltip: When enabled, Saw All Logs places planks at your feet instead of inventory. Useful for players without weight-reduction mods.
Sandbox_EnableStairSense_tooltip: Show a warning icon and text when zombies are detected above you on stairs.
Sandbox_EnableTowelDrying_tooltip: Allow players to use towels, sheets, and rags to dry off when wet.
Sandbox_EnableSleepAnywhere_tooltip: Allow players to sleep on the ground without a bed. Low quality sleep.
Sandbox_EnableDismantleAllWatches_toolti: Batch dismantle watches and alarm clocks into electronics scrap with a screwdriver.
Sandbox_EnableMassage_tooltip: Allow players to massage another player's strained muscles using butter or cooking oil.
Sandbox_EnableHideInFurniture_tooltip: Right-click closets, dumpsters, and fridges to hide inside. Zombies cannot see you while hiding.
Sandbox_EnablePointBlank_tooltip: Massive accuracy boost when aiming a firearm at a zombie within 2 tiles. Also applies bonus damage at point-blank range.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleSalvage_tooltip: Salvage abandoned vehicles for scrap metal and materials. Requires propane torch, welding mask, Mechanics 3+, Metal Welding 3+. Vehicle is destroyed on completion.
Sandbox_EnableItemRename_tooltip: Right-click any item to rename it. Names persist across saves. Use Reset Item Name to revert.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHVAC_tooltip: Show a temperature slider on the vehicle dashboard for heating and cooling. Replaces the vanilla heater popup.
Sandbox_EnableEatWhileDriving_tooltip: Allows the driver to eat or smoke while in a vehicle, including while it is moving. Two-handed foods (pots, large bowls) are still blocked. Animation is suppressed since the player rig is locked to the seat. Disable for a stricter realism profile.
Sandbox_EatWhileDrivingMaxSpeed_tooltip: Above this speed the eat / smoke option is greyed out for safety. Set to 0 to require the vehicle to be fully stopped. Default 60.
Sandbox_EnableBinksScooper: Enable Bink's No Stinks: Pooper Scooper
Sandbox_EnableBinksScooper_tooltip: Adds a craftable shovel-class tool that scoops vanilla animal dung (chicken, cow, deer, mouse, pig, rabbit, raccoon, rat, sheep, turkey) within a configurable radius. Recipe: 1 Shovel + 1 Duct Tape + 1 Plank. Default ON.
Sandbox_BinksScooperRadius_tooltip: Radius around the player searched for dung when using the scoop option. Range 1-6. Default 3.
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction: Bink's Scooper: max scoops per action
Sandbox_BinksScooperMaxPerAction_tooltip: Cap on how many dung items a single scoop action can clear. Higher values let one click clean a denser farm yard but cost more time. Range 10-60. Default 30.
Sandbox_EnableFoodExpiryTooltip: Show food expiry on item tooltips
Sandbox_EnableFoodExpiryTooltip_tooltip: Adds two extra lines to food tooltips: estimated days/hours of freshness at room temperature, and projected days inside a fridge. Uses the item's per-instance offAgeMax + your live FoodRotSpeed and FridgeFactor sandbox settings, so values match what the game will actually do. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableCharacterInfoEnhancements_: Show a nutrition panel below the character screen with weight, calories, protein, carbs, and fats.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleRadio_tooltip: Replaces the vanilla radio popup with an always-visible radio panel on the dashboard. Volume knob (left) adjusts volume or toggles power on click. Tune knob (right) changes frequency. LCD shows station name and frequency.
Sandbox_EnableHideWatermark_tooltip: Remove the version/build watermark text from the screen.
Sandbox_EnableSleepBenefits_tooltip: While sleeping, boredom decreases by 1.5 and unhappiness decreases by 0.5 every 10 in-game minutes.
Sandbox_EnableBagBottomAttach_tooltip: Allow weapons like rifles, shovels, bats, and blades to visually attach to the bottom of backpacks (bedroll slots). Supports regular, big, and ALICE backpacks.
Sandbox_EnableNestedContainers_tooltip: Show containers inside containers as separate buttons in the inventory sidebar. A bag inside a backpack gets its own clickable button. Supports up to 2 levels of nesting.
Sandbox_EnableLootBag_tooltip: Add a single 'Nearby Loot' tab to the loot panel that aggregates items from every reachable nearby container, including bags inside loot containers. Server sandbox controls whether this feature is allowed; when allowed, each player can still toggle their own preference.
Sandbox_EnableLootBagAutoTrunk_tooltip: When you walk up to a vehicle, automatically select its trunk as the active loot tab the first time it becomes reachable, instead of the floor. Click any other tab to override; the trunk is not re-pinned until you walk away and back.
Sandbox_EnableToolSet_tooltip: Craft combined tool items (tool roll, toolbox) that count as multiple tools at once. Uses engine-native tags so they work everywhere -- crafting, building, vehicle mechanics.
Sandbox_EnableMaterialBundles_tooltip: Allow tying planks, metal materials, pipes, bars, branches, and wooden rods into reduced-weight bundles. Existing CSR bundles can still be unbundled when this is disabled.
Sandbox_EnableBulletPenetration_tooltip: Bullets can pass through killed zombies and damage zombies behind them. Auto-detects weapon stats so it works with any gun mod.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationMode_tooltip: Kill Only: bullets only penetrate when the initial hit kills the zombie. Non-Lethal: bullets can penetrate on any hit above a damage threshold.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationDamageScale_too: Multiplier for penetration damage. 0.4 = penetrating bullets deal 40% of the original damage to the next zombie.
Sandbox_BulletPenetrationMaxTargets_tool: Maximum number of additional zombies a bullet can hit after the primary target.
Sandbox_EnableThrowableItems_tooltip: Allows players to throw CSR-approved junk items, unopened cans, and knives from the world context menu. The server validates every item and blocks guns, ammo, bags, random weapons, keys, and containers.
Sandbox_ThrowableMaxRange_tooltip: Hard server cap, in tiles, for thrown items. Individual item profiles may throw shorter than this. Default 12.
Sandbox_ThrowableNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales zombie-attracting impact sound. 0 disables throw impact noise; 1.0 is normal; 3.0 is loud.
Sandbox_ThrowableDamageMultiplier_toolti: Scales impact damage to zombies near the landing square. Set 0 to keep throwables as distraction-only.
Sandbox_ThrowableBreakChanceMultiplier_t: Scales the chance for fragile thrown items like glass and plates to break instead of landing on the ground.
Sandbox_EnableBack2Slot_tooltip: Adds a second weapon slot on the character's back. Carry two large weapons at once -- one on each shoulder.
Sandbox_EnableWarmUp_tooltip: Adds a context menu option to warm your hands when body temperature is below 36.6C and falling. Uses the vanilla hand-warming animation.
Sandbox_EnableStopDropRoll_tooltip: When on fire, a context menu option appears to drop and roll to extinguish flames. Damages clothing in the process. Lucky trait improves success, Unlucky makes it worse.
Sandbox_EnableConeVisionOutline_tooltip: Highlights zombies within your forward vision cone with a colored outline. Requires the vanilla melee outline option to be enabled in game settings.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutlineRange_tooltip: Maximum distance in tiles for the zombie vision-cone outline. Higher values may impact performance.
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutlineColorR_tooltip: Red component of the vision-cone outline color. Default 178 (vibrant purple).
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutlineColorG_tooltip: Green component of the vision-cone outline color. Default 51 (vibrant purple).
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutlineColorB_tooltip: Blue component of the vision-cone outline color. Default 255 (vibrant purple).
Sandbox_ConeVisionOutlineAlpha_tooltip: Intensity / opacity of the vision-cone outline. 5 = very faint, 100 = fully opaque. Default 35.
Sandbox_EnableExerciseWithGear_tooltip: Prevents the fitness system from unequipping bags and clothing when exercising. Your character keeps all gear on.
Sandbox_EnableInfectionResilience_toolti: Gives zombie-infected players a small chance to survive the infection. The infection converts to a fever they can recover from.
Sandbox_InfResChanceToHeal_tooltip: Base percentage chance to survive a zombie infection. Reduced by the penalty multiplier for each infected body part. Default: 10%.
Sandbox_InfResPenaltyMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplier applied per infected body part. Higher values make multiple bites much harder to survive. Formula: chance / (penalty ^ parts). Default: 1.5.
Sandbox_InfResThresholdMin_tooltip: Minimum infection progression percentage before the survival roll can occur. Lower values mean the roll happens sooner. Default: 70%.
Sandbox_InfResThresholdMax_tooltip: Maximum infection progression percentage for the survival roll. A random threshold between min and max is chosen per infection. Default: 95%.
Sandbox_EnableAntibodySystem_tooltip: Adds a CSR antibody panel, survival-chance modifiers, immunity growth after surviving bites, and immune blood serum collection.
Sandbox_AntibodyGrowthPerHour_tooltip: How quickly antibody response grows while truly infected. Health, wounds, care, and serum can raise or lower the effective rate. Default: 18.
Sandbox_AntibodyDecayPerHour_tooltip: How quickly temporary antibody response fades when not infected. Permanent immunity progress does not decay. Default: 12.
Sandbox_AntibodyRollBonusPerPoint: Antibodies - roll bonus per response point
Sandbox_AntibodyRollBonusPerPoint_toolti: Extra survival-roll chance gained per current antibody response point. Default: 0.20.
Sandbox_AntibodyImmunityRollBonusPerPoin: Antibodies - roll bonus per immunity point
Extra survival-roll chance gained per permanent immunity point before full immunity. Default: 0.25.
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGain_tooltip: Base permanent immunity gained after surviving a true Knox infection. Default: 25.
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGainPerPart: Antibodies - extra gain per infected part
Sandbox_AntibodySurvivalGainPerPart_tool: Extra permanent immunity gained for each infected body part when the player survives. Default: 5.
Sandbox_AntibodyImmunityThreshold_toolti: Permanent immunity value at which future true infections are neutralized automatically. Default: 100.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumPower_tooltip: Survival-roll bonus granted by immune blood serum before First Aid scaling. Default: 15.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours an injected serum boost lasts. Default: 8.
Sandbox_AntibodySerumImmediateBoost_tool: Instant antibody response added when serum is injected. Default: 8.
Sandbox_AntibodySampleShelfHours_tooltip: How many in-game hours an immune blood syringe remains viable. Default: 72.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawCooldownHours_toolti: How many in-game hours an immune donor must wait between blood draws. Default: 24.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawHealthCost_tooltip: Overall health removed from the immune donor when a sample is collected. Default: 4.
Sandbox_AntibodyDrawMinHealth_tooltip: Minimum overall health required before a donor can provide immune blood. Default: 35.
Sandbox_EnableUsefulBarrels_tooltip: Allows uncapping vanilla barrel objects with a pipe wrench, turning them into fluid containers that collect rain and can be filled or drained.
Sandbox_UsefulBarrelCapacity_tooltip: Maximum fluid capacity of an uncapped barrel in litres. Default: 400.
Sandbox_EnableClimbWithBags_tooltip: Keep bags in your hands when climbing through windows or over fences. Heavier bags increase climb time.
Sandbox_EnableFieldFilters_tooltip: Allows crafting makeshift respirator and gas mask filters from common materials. Also enables the filter lifespan multiplier.
Sandbox_FilterLifespanMultiplier_tooltip: How many times longer ALL mask filters last. 1 = vanilla speed (default). 10 = filters last 10x as long.
Sandbox_EnableTowAssist_tooltip: Adds a forward impulse boost to vehicles while towing, reducing sluggishness. Force scales with both vehicle masses. Auto-disabled when Realistic Car Physics is active (incompatible impulse stacking).
Sandbox_TowAssistStandardFactor_tooltip: Force multiplier for standard vehicles while towing. 0 = disabled. Default: 5.0.
Sandbox_TowAssistHeavyDutyFactor_tooltip: Force multiplier for heavy-duty vehicles while towing. 0 = disabled. Default: 7.0.
Sandbox_TowAssistSportFactor_tooltip: Force multiplier for sport vehicles while towing. 0 = disabled. Default: 4.0.
Sandbox_EnableGeneratorInfo_tooltip: Enhanced generator info window with fuel time remaining, fuel gauge bar, and purple power range overlay when carrying or inspecting a generator.
Sandbox_EnableWearableSlotFix_tooltip: Moves ear muffs and ear protectors from the Hat slot to the Ears slot so they can be worn with hats, helmets, and other headwear.
Sandbox_EnableClimbWithGenerator_tooltip: Allows climbing through windows, over fences, and up/down sheet ropes while holding a generator. Applies a heavy time penalty based on generator weight.
Sandbox_EnableNoticeBoard_tooltip: Read and write messages on paper notices and whiteboards in the world. Requires a pen or marker.
Sandbox_EnableVideoInsert_tooltip: Adds 'Insert Video' and 'Eject Video' context menu options when near a TV or VCR. Insert shows all compatible VHS tapes or DVDs in your inventory.
Sandbox_EnableTVRadial: Enable TV / VCR / Radio radial menu
Sandbox_EnableTVRadial_tooltip: Press the TV Radial hotkey (default Numpad 9, rebindable) near a TV, VCR, or radio to open a controller-friendly radial menu with Power, Volume +/-, and Insert/Eject controls.
Sandbox_EnableReplaceVanillaSafehouseUI: Route vanilla Safehouse menu to CSR Claims Manager
Sandbox_EnableReplaceVanillaSafehouseUI_: When ON (default), right-clicking a tile and choosing the vanilla "View Safehouse" / "Safehouse" option opens the unified CSR Claims Manager (Personal / Faction / Vehicle tabs) instead of the vanilla safehouse window. The vanilla window remains accessible from the User Panel and from an in-window button. Turn OFF to keep the vanilla window as the default.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleClaimEnforcementStr: When ON (default), CSR blocks bypass paths on claimed vehicles you do not own: hotwire, smashing windows, installing/uninstalling parts, taking engine parts, locking/unlocking doors, and siphoning gas. Owners, admins, faction members, and allowed-listed users are unaffected. Zombie attacks are NOT blocked. Turn OFF to make claims advisory only (visible owner badge but no action gates).
Sandbox_EnableAnimatedDuffles: Animated duffel bags on lower back
Sandbox_EnableAnimatedDuffles_tooltip: When ON (default), large duffel-class bags (Duffel, Weapon, Tool, Police, SWAT, Sheriff, Military, Medical, etc.) gain a right-click "Equip on Back > Equip on Lower Back" option that places the bag on a separate Lower Back slot using a 3D rigged model that animates with your character. This frees the upper Back slot for a backpack. Disable to remove the menu entry.
Sandbox_EnableAimingAmmoCursor_tooltip: Shows a floating ammo pill near your cursor while aiming. Toggle independently from the main Weapon HUD Overlay.
Sandbox_EnableAimingHealthCursor_tooltip: Shows a small HP pill near your cursor while aiming. Color shifts from green to violet as you take damage.
Sandbox_EnableAimingDensityCursor_toolti: Shows a nearby zombie count pill near your cursor while aiming. Default OFF to avoid duplicating the standalone Nearby Density HUD.
Sandbox_EnableGearSling_tooltip: Adds a second equip slot for sling-style and shoulder bags, so you can carry a satchel, duffel, or chest rig alongside your main backpack.
Sandbox_EnableRallyPoints_tooltip: Allows players to pin a rally point on the world map and share it with all online players. The map shows a route line to the waypoint and auto-clears when you arrive.
Sandbox_EnableRankings_tooltip: Persistent multiplayer scoreboard tracking zombie kills, deaths, hours survived, distance walked and XP. Adds a sidebar button to open the rankings window. Disabling stops all tracking and hides the button.
Sandbox_RankingsTrackPvP_tooltip: When ON, player kills (PvP) are tracked separately from zombie kills. Default OFF for PvE servers.
Sandbox_RankingsRetentionDays_tooltip: How many days of daily history to keep per player. Older buckets are pruned. Larger values use more save space.
Sandbox_RankingsHistoryGraphBuckets_tool: Number of recent days shown on the per-player kill timeline graph. Cannot exceed retention.
Sandbox_RankingsAllowAnonymousView_toolt: When ON, all players can open the rankings window. When OFF, only admins (access level Admin or Moderator) can view it.
Sandbox_EnableSkillJournal_tooltip: Pure-UI skill recovery system. A 'Journal' button on the Utility HUD opens a panel where you can save a server-side snapshot of your current perk levels (and the recipes / read magazines you know) and restore them after dying. No physical item, recipe, or animation -- the snapshot is keyed to your Steam ID and survives respawn. Disabling stops all tracking and hides the button.
Sandbox_SkillJournalMinPlayHours_tooltip: Minimum hours survived on the current character before the first snapshot can be saved. Prevents save-then-suicide exploits on fresh characters. 0 = no gate.
Sandbox_SkillJournalSaveCooldownHours_to: Minimum in-game hours between two consecutive snapshot saves. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_SkillJournalDeathPenalty_tooltip: Levels subtracted from every saved skill on each death before recovery applies. 0 = full restore. 1 or -1 = one-level penalty (default is 1). 5 or -5 = harsh.
Sandbox_SkillJournalAdminOnlyRecover_too: When ON, only admins (or moderators) may press the Recover button. Players can still save snapshots; recovery requires admin sign-off. Useful for hardcore servers that want supervised restoration.
Sandbox_SkillJournalRealHoursCooldown_to: Real-world wall-clock hours that must elapse between two snapshot saves. Independent of in-game time, sleep, or time-skip -- prevents the 'die, respawn fresh, race to re-save better stats' exploit. 0 = disabled. Default 24.
Sandbox_SkillJournalProfessionLock_toolt: When ON, the first Save binds the journal row to your character's profession. Future saves require the same profession, so dying and respawning under a different profession cannot overwrite the snapshot with better stats. Admins can wipe rows from the Blacklist panel. Default ON.
Sandbox_RallyRequirePencil_tooltip: When ON, setting and sharing a rally point requires a pencil or pen in your inventory. The waypoint is auto-erased on arrival, so eraser is not separately required.
Sandbox_VehicleClaimPunishmentTier_toolt: Maximum punishment ceiling when a non-allowed player is seated in a claimed vehicle. 0 = Off (just eject). 1 = Warn. 2 = Shock. 3 = Burn (destructive). 4 = Lethal (burn + injury). Tier escalates one step every 7 seconds the player stays seated, capped at this ceiling. The 3rd offence on the same vehicle in one session is fatal regardless of the ceiling.
Sandbox_VehicleClaimAutoLethalActions_to: When ON, hotwiring, prying or lockpicking a claimed vehicle, or opening any of its doors, trunk, or glovebox triggers an immediate Tier 4 punishment (burn + injury) regardless of the configured ceiling. When OFF, those actions fall back to the regular seated-time escalation. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableColoredToggles_tooltip: When ON, the CSR Settings panel (S button on the Utility HUD) renders ON toggles green and OFF toggles red. When OFF, falls back to vanilla button styling. Does not affect the vanilla Sandbox Options screen.
Sandbox_EnableSurvivorBond_tooltip: Players who stay near each other for an extended time gradually reduce stress, boredom, fatigue, and unhappiness together.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondRadius_tooltip: Distance in tiles within which another player counts as nearby for the bond effect.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondThreshold_tooltip: How many real-time seconds players must remain near each other before the bond effect begins.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondReduceStress_tooltip: When Survivor Bond is active, gradually reduces each player's stress.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondReduceBoredom_toolti: When Survivor Bond is active, gradually reduces each player's boredom.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondReduceFatigue_toolti: When Survivor Bond is active, gradually reduces each player's fatigue.
Sandbox_SurvivorBondReduceUnhappy_toolti: When Survivor Bond is active, gradually reduces each player's unhappiness.
Sandbox_EnableSurvivorLedger_tooltip: Displays a compact strip of survival statistics on screen: days survived, zombie kills, distance traveled, character weight, session kills, and average kills per day.
Sandbox_EnableFactionMemberLimit_tooltip: Caps the number of players a faction can have. When a faction reaches the limit the owner cannot send further invites until a member leaves.
Sandbox_MaxFactionMembers_tooltip: Maximum number of players allowed in a single faction (2–32). The faction owner counts as one member.
Sandbox_EnableFactionSafehouse_tooltip: Allow faction owners to claim safehouses on behalf of their faction.
Sandbox_MaxFactionSafehouses_tooltip: Maximum number of safehouses a faction can claim (1-5).
Sandbox_FactionClaimPadding_tooltip: Minimum distance (in tiles) that must separate a new faction safehouse from any existing safehouse. 0 disables.
Sandbox_FactionClaimSpawnRadius_tooltip: Faction safehouse claims are rejected if within this radius of a vanilla spawn region. Only used when 'Respect spawn protection' is on.
Sandbox_FactionClaimRespectSpawn_tooltip: Reject faction safehouse claims that fall within the spawn protection radius of a known spawn region.
Sandbox_FactionClaimResidentialOnly_tool: When enabled, faction safehouses can only be claimed in buildings that look residential (have at least one kitchen / bedroom / livingroom / bathroom room).
Sandbox_EnableLadderClimb_tooltip: Lets players climb vanilla world ladders by reusing the engine's sheet-rope state machine. Press the Interact key while standing at the foot or top of a ladder. Disable to fall back to vanilla behaviour. Cooperative no-op if another ladder mod is loaded.
Sandbox_EnableClaimRespawn_tooltip: Lets players pin a personal or faction safehouse claim as their respawn point. After death the player auto-teleports to the pinned claim. The pinned safehouse is also flagged as a vanilla map-spawn option. Vehicle claims are not eligible. Disable to fall back to vanilla respawn behaviour.
Sandbox_EnableReloadAllMags_tooltip: Adds a 'Reload All Mags' slice to the firearm radial menu (hold R) and a 'Reload All' option to the right-click menu of any magazine in your inventory. Reloads every not-full magazine of the matching type in sequence.
Sandbox_EnableSeatedReloadBonus_tooltip: Grants a 20% reload-speed bonus while sitting on furniture or the ground. Mirrors the vanilla 20% reload-speed PENALTY for seated drivers, applied as a bonus for non-vehicle sitting.
Sandbox_EnableGroundMarking_tooltip: Allow players to right-click the ground to spray directional arrows and survival symbols. Requires SprayPaint (permanent marks) or Crayons (marks degrade on next rain). MP-safe: placement is server-authoritative.
Sandbox_EnableRVExitRescue_tooltip: Adds a CSR emergency right-click exit inside ProjectRV interiors. The server only teleports players to validated saved non-interior coordinates from ProjectRV or CSR last-safe data.
Sandbox_EnableRoomScanner_tooltip: Right-click an interior tile or use the panel to scan the current room for items, containers, exits, and notable hazards. Useful for clearing safehouses or surveying loot before triggering noise.
Sandbox_AdminAuthoritativeControl_toolti: When ON, only logged-in admins can change CSR sandbox options at runtime via the in-game settings panel. Recommended for public servers. Default OFF (any sandbox-allowed user can adjust).
Sandbox_EnableFridgeToggle_tooltip: Adds a right-click option on fridges and freezers to toggle their power draw on or off without disconnecting the whole house from the grid. Useful for conserving generator fuel.
Sandbox_EnableWashAll_tooltip: Adds a 'Wash Everything' option on water sources that washes your body, recursively cleans every dirty item in your inventory (including bag contents), and replaces dirty bandages with clean ones in a single action. Server-validated.
Sandbox_WashAllWaterPerItem_tooltip: Water cost (in litres) consumed per dirty item the action processes.
Sandbox_WashAllSecondsPerItem_tooltip: Animation time scales linearly with dirty item count using this many seconds per item.
Sandbox_EnableJarCapping_tooltip: Right-click a jar in inventory while holding a Jar Lid to seal it. Sealed jars rename to 'Sealed <name>'. Uncap returns the lid.
Sandbox_EnableHomeCanning_tooltip: Adds craft recipes to convert empty tin cans + a jar lid + ingredients into vanilla canned items (Canned Milk, Canned Fruit Cocktail, Tinned Soup, Water Ration). Requires Cooking 2-3. Auto-hides if a third-party canning mod is loaded.
Sandbox_EnableRouletteSession_tooltip: Multiplayer-only feature. Right-click a loaded revolver to invite nearby players into a turn-based Russian Roulette session. The kill chamber is server-rolled and hidden. Each pull rolls 1-6; matching the kill chamber kills the firing player.
Sandbox_RouletteRerollEachLap: Roulette - reroll kill chamber each lap
Sandbox_RouletteRerollEachLap_tooltip: When ON, the hidden kill chamber is re-rolled at the start of every full circle of pulls. Default OFF keeps the same chamber for the entire session.
Sandbox_RouletteRealDeath_tooltip: When ON, a lethal Russian Roulette outcome is applied by the server as a real character death. When OFF, the session keeps its existing cinematic outcome behavior. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableLastResortHarvest_tooltip: Adds a 'Field Dress' option on dead bodies when carrying a sharp knife. Yields corpse-flesh food (mostly past-fresh) and possibly an Animal Bone. Disabled by default. Animal corpses are skipped (use vanilla skinning).
Sandbox_AllowHumanHarvest: Allow Field Dress on Human Bodies
Sandbox_AllowHumanHarvest_tooltip: If ON, dead player corpses can also be field-dressed into human flesh. Causes stress and unhappiness when performed and again when eaten. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_LastResortFreshChancePct: Field Dress - chance meat is fresh
Sandbox_LastResortFreshChancePct_tooltip: Percent chance each cut of meat comes out fresh instead of pushed near the rotting threshold.
Sandbox_LastResortMeatYield_tooltip: Number of corpse-flesh items produced per successful field dress.
Sandbox_LastResortKnifeDamage_tooltip: Condition lost on the knife per use.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleCabinFilter_tooltip: Reduces corpse-sickness gain while inside a vehicle. Strength scales with how sealed the cabin is - intact windows, closed doors, intact windshield. A running heater further dampens the effect. Auto-disables if a third-party cabin sickness mod is loaded.
Sandbox_CabinFilterStrength_tooltip: Maximum reduction applied when the cabin is fully sealed. 0 disables. 1 fully blocks corpse sickness gain in a perfect cabin.
Sandbox_CabinFilterHeaterBoost_tooltip: Additional multiplier applied when the vehicle heater is running. Lower values mean stronger filtering with a heater on.
Sandbox_EnableRodentCuisine_tooltip: Tweaks vanilla skinned mice and rats so cooking them removes unhappiness, they slot into Mouse and Rat evolved recipes, and they count as Game food. No new items added.
Sandbox_EnableRadioPlugIn_tooltip: Placed radios on a powered tile run on mains power instead of draining their battery.
Sandbox_EnablePowerBarCable_tooltip: Right-click a Power Bar in your inventory while standing on a powered tile to plug it in. Each Electric Wire invested extends its powered zone by 1 tile (Manhattan distance).
Sandbox_PowerBarMaxCableLength_tooltip: Maximum tiles of reach a single Power Bar can be extended to with Electric Wires.
Sandbox_PowerBarCableReturnPct_tooltip: Percentage of invested Electric Wires returned when a Power Bar is unplugged.
Sandbox_EnablePowerLine_tooltip: Right-click a powered tile to start a blue cord. Walk to lay cable, right-click an unpowered tile to End Power Line Here. One Power Bar is consumed and every painted tile becomes a permanently powered tile.
Sandbox_PowerLineMaxLength_tooltip: Maximum number of tiles a single Power Bar can power along the painted cord.
Sandbox_EnablePowerLineBatteryPlacebo: Power Line keeps batteries topped up
Sandbox_EnablePowerLineBatteryPlacebo_to: While standing on a Power Line tile, drainable battery items (flashlights, lighters, lanterns) in your inventory are kept charged — flavor only, no XP, no stats.
Sandbox_EnableOutfitSets_tooltip: Right-click a wardrobe / dresser / locker / shelves / clothes stand to save and recall outfits. Best-condition match across player + wardrobe + (optionally) the rest of the room. Inspired by Yuki's Outfit Control mod, used with permission.
Sandbox_OutfitSetsAccess_tooltip: Anywhere: works on any wardrobe-class furniture. Safehouse Only: only inside a safehouse you own / are a member of. Recommended Anywhere for SP, Safehouse Only for MP.
Sandbox_OutfitSetsMultiContainerScan_too: When using Outfit Sets inside a safehouse, search every container in the same room (or a 4-tile radius if room detection fails) instead of just the clicked one. Treats your bedroom as the wardrobe.
Sandbox_OutfitSetsMaxSlots_tooltip: Maximum number of named outfits you can save. Old slots can be deleted to make room.
Sandbox_OutfitSetsWardrobeBonusPct_toolt: Increases the storage capacity of any wardrobe-class furniture (Wardrobes, Dressers, Lockers, Shelves, Clothes Stands, etc.) by this percentage. Applied once per object on first interaction. 0 = vanilla.
Sandbox_PowerBarExtendsGenerator_tooltip: When the anchor tile is powered by an active generator, the Power Bar zone counts as generator-powered as well.
Sandbox_EnablePowerBarRangeOverlay_toolt: Draws a translucent diamond around each placed Power Bar showing its current cable reach. Cyan = energized, grey = no power. Disable for a cleaner look.
Sandbox_PowerBarOverloadFireChancePctPer: Power Bar overload fire chance per hour (%)
Maximum per-hour chance that an energized Power Bar at full cable reach starts a small fire on its own tile. Scales quadratically with how close to maximum reach the bar is. 0 disables the risk.
Sandbox_PowerBarPhantomGenerator_tooltip: EXPERIMENTAL. When ON, each placed Power Bar quietly anchors a hidden generator at its tile so vanilla appliances within its real coverage register as powered (lamps, fridges, stoves, freezers, microwaves). The hidden generator burns no fuel and emits no sound; it follows the upstream supply (mains or a real generator) and shuts off the moment that supply does. Caveats: a real Java generator object lives on the tile while the bar is plugged in, so removing the mod mid-save can leave a stray generator behind. Default OFF.
Sandbox_EnableEVConversion_tooltip: Adds a Convert to Electric option on vehicles. Converted vehicles run on a charge meter instead of fuel and recharge from a Car Battery Charger placed in a Power Bar zone.
Sandbox_EVRequiredBatteries_tooltip: Number of Car Batteries consumed when converting a vehicle to electric.
Sandbox_EVRequiredWires_tooltip: Number of Electric Wires consumed when converting a vehicle to electric.
Sandbox_EVTrunkPenaltyKg_tooltip: Effective weight penalty applied to converted vehicles to represent the battery pack.
Sandbox_EVChargeFromChargerPctPerHour: EV: Charge per hour at charger (%)
Sandbox_EVChargeFromChargerPctPerHour_to: Percentage of charge gained per game-hour while parked next to a Car Battery Charger inside a Power Bar zone.
Sandbox_EVDrainPerKmAt100Throttle_toolti: Charge drain (1/100 of a percentage point per km) when driving at full throttle.
Sandbox_EVConvertMechanicsLevel_tooltip: Minimum Mechanics skill the player must have to convert a vehicle to electric.
Sandbox_EVConvertElectricalLevel_tooltip: Minimum Electrical skill the player must have to convert a vehicle to electric.
Sandbox_EnableRainCleanse_tooltip: Outdoor rain and snow gradually wash blood and dirt off the ground, building exteriors, your skin, your worn clothing, equipped weapons, equipped bags, and parked vehicles. Driven by the actual weather intensity and your character's wetness. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableRainCleanseExteriors_toolt: When ON, rain and snow may wash blood and grime from weather-exposed exterior wall surfaces near players. Uses vanilla square stain cleanup only and avoids sprite replacement. Default ON.
Sandbox_RainCleanseTilesPerTick: Rain Cleanse: tiles scanned per tick
Sandbox_RainCleanseTilesPerTick_tooltip: How many random outdoor ground tiles are checked for blood each game tick. Higher = a heavy storm clears blood faster but costs more CPU. Range 1-32. Default 8.
Sandbox_RainCleanseSpeedFactor_tooltip: Global multiplier on how fast blood and dirt fade from skin, clothing, weapons, bags, and vehicles. 1.0 is the calibrated baseline. Default 1.0.
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicate_tooltip: Adds a fictional rescue contractor named Knox Syndicate. Right-click any working radio (inventory or vehicle) and select Call in Knox Syndicate to summon a 90-second helicopter strafing run that culls nearby zombies, but the engine noise also draws fresh horde attention. Subject to a long cooldown. Default OFF.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateDurationSec_tooltip: How many real seconds the helicopter stays on station after a successful call. Range 30-300. Default 90.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateKillIntervalSec_too: How often (in seconds) the helicopter takes a shot at the closest zombie around the protected player. Lower values = faster horde clearance. Range 1-10. Default 2.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateRangeTiles_tooltip: Maximum tile distance from the protected player at which the helicopter will engage zombies. Range 4-20. Default 12.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateCooldownHours_toolt: How many in-game hours must pass between calls per player. Range 1-168. Default 24.
Sandbox_KnoxSyndicateNoiseRadius_tooltip: How loud the helicopter is to zombies (world sound radius pulsed each shot). Larger values mean more zombies will path toward you during the support run. Range 5-60. Default 30.
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicateBroadcast: Knox Syndicate: passive radio broadcast on 100.8 FM
Sandbox_EnableKnoxSyndicateBroadcast_too: When ON, registers a Knox Syndicate intercept loop on 100.8 FM. Tune any working radio (hand or vehicle) to 100.8 to hear the broadcast and learn how to call in support. The support call feature still works with this disabled.
Sandbox_EnableRoofClimb_tooltip: Right-click a parked vehicle and choose Climb onto roof to scramble up for a higher vantage. Right-click again on the vehicle to climb down. Auto-disabled when More Car Features (WayMoreCars) or ClimbableVehicles is loaded. Default ON.
Sandbox_RoofClimbPeerVisualSync_tooltip: Experimental MP visual fix. When ON, players standing on the same vehicle roof render each other at roof height. No server teleport is used. Default OFF.
Sandbox_RoofClimbStrengthRequired_toolti: Minimum Strength skill required to climb onto a normal car or sedan. Range 0-10. Default 3.
Sandbox_RoofClimbTallStrengthRequired_to: Minimum Strength required to climb onto vans, pickups, step vans and military trucks. Range 0-10. Default 5.
Sandbox_RoofClimbFallDamage: Roof Climb: take fall damage when jumping down
Sandbox_RoofClimbFallDamage_tooltip: When ON, jumping straight down from a tall vehicle roof can scratch ankles or fracture a leg. When OFF, dismounts are always safe. Default ON.
Sandbox_RoofClimbZombieVisibility: Roof Climb: zombie sight % while on roof
Sandbox_RoofClimbZombieVisibility_toolti: Roughly how visible the player is to zombies while standing on a vehicle roof. 100 = same as ground. Lower values let you scout safely. Range 0-100. Default 50.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleWeatherExposure_too: When the windshield is missing, a door is missing or open, or a window is open or shattered, rain and snow get inside the cabin. Wets your clothes first (water-resistant gear helps), then your body. Driving forward into the weather makes it worse. Default OFF.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherIntensity_tooltip: Global multiplier on cabin wetness accrual. 100 = baseline. Range 0-200. Default 100.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherTemperature_toolti: When ON, exposure to cold rain or snow inside an open or breached cabin also chills the player. Default ON.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherForagePenalty: Vehicle Weather: missing windshield reduces sight
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherForagePenalty_tool: When ON, driving without a windshield (or with one shattered) lowers your foraging sight while inside the cab, simulating wind/rain in your eyes. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHoodCraft: Enable vehicle hood as crafting surface
Sandbox_EnableVehicleHoodCraft_tooltip: Stand next to a parked car with the hood closed and you can craft any "any-surface" recipe on the hood (cleaning weapons, repairs, splints, simple kits). Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleCraftSurfaces_toolt: Master toggle for the vehicle craft-surface system (hood + trunk). Disable to turn off both. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleTrunkCraft: Enable vehicle trunk/cargo as crafting surface
Sandbox_EnableVehicleTrunkCraft_tooltip: Stand next to a parked car or truck with a reachable trunk, truck bed, trailer, or cargo bay and you can craft any "any-surface" recipe on it. Auto-yields if a dedicated trunk-craft mod is loaded. Default ON.
Sandbox_EnableTrunkSpillage_tooltip: When ON, hard crashes or rough driving can fling items from open or exposed trunks onto the ground. Closed trunks keep cargo inside. Default OFF.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMaxItemsPerCrash: Trunk spillage: max items per crash
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMaxItemsPerCrash_to: Hard cap on how many items can be ejected from a trunk in a single crash event. Default 15.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageDriveChance_tooltip: Per-tick chance multiplier (0-200%) that rough driving (not just full crashes) shakes items loose. 100 = baseline. 0 disables drive-shake entirely.
Sandbox_TrunkSpillageMinSpeed_tooltip: Vehicles slower than this never spill cargo, regardless of impact. Default 20 km/h.
Sandbox_EnableRopeTow_tooltip: Allow players to attach a rope between two vehicles to drag a stalled or low-fuel vehicle. Disable to remove the context option.
Sandbox_EnableFireTrail_tooltip: Allow lighting a trail of fuel from a gas can to create a delayed ignition line. Useful for traps and crowd control.
Sandbox_FireTrailMaxLength_tooltip: Maximum length, in tiles, that a single fire trail can extend before auto-stopping. Default 25.
Sandbox_FireTrailFuelPerTile_tooltip: Gasoline consumed per tile of trail laid. Lower values are more economical; higher values force scarcity. Default 0.05.
Sandbox_FireTrailRequiresAdmin_tooltip: MP only. When enabled, only admins can lay fire trails. Use to prevent griefing on public servers.
Sandbox_EnableBathing_tooltip: Adds a 'Take A Bath' context option on filled bathtubs. Cleans blood and dirt, removes wetness afterward, and (optionally) clears all muscle strain.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffHeadwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip hats, masks, and eyewear before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffClothes_tooltip: Auto-unequip jackets, shirts, pants, shoes, etc. before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffUnderwear_tooltip: Auto-unequip undergarments before entering the tub. Off by default.
Sandbox_BathingTakeOffBackpack_tooltip: Auto-unequip backpacks and fanny packs before entering the tub.
Sandbox_BathingWaterCost_tooltip: Liters of water drained from the tub per bath. Set to 0 for free bathing. Default 40.
Sandbox_BathingClearsMuscleStrain_toolti: A finished bath removes all accumulated muscle strain (stiffness) on every body part.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleWeatherIngress_tool: When ON, riding in a vehicle with a missing windshield exposes you to rain (wetness) and outside cold. Open or smashed side windows let cold air in too. Default ON.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherWetnessRate_toolti: Scales how fast you get wet from rain blowing in through a missing windshield. 100 is default, 0 disables wetness without disabling cold.
Sandbox_VehicleWeatherColdRate_tooltip: Scales body-temperature drop from open or broken windows / windshields when outside air is cold. 100 is default, 0 disables cold without disabling wetness.
